references.text: Samson went down to the woman, and his father held a feast there, as young men were accustomed to do
Laban gathered all the men of the place and held a feast, similar to a wedding celebration with guests
The wedding at Cana where Jesus and his disciples were invited as guests shows the custom of having many guests at weddings
John the Baptist mentions the friends of the bridegroom who stand and listen to him, a reference to wedding guests and the bridegroom's entourage
Jesus refers to the friends of the bridegroom who are with the bridegroom, similar to the thirty friends who were with Samson
Samson's wife was given to one of his friends who had been his best man, one of the thirty men mentioned here
